==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|banck|bancke|banke||obsolete}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{a|en|non-æ-tensing}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈbæŋk/|[ˈbæŋk]|a=RP,GA,AU!Australia}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈbaŋk/|[ˈbaŋk]|a=SSB,Northern England,Scotland,Wales}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈbɛŋk/|[ˈbɛŋk]|a=NZ}}
* {{a|en|æ-tensing}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈbeɪ̯ŋk/|[ˈbeɪ̯ŋk]|;|/ˈbɛ̃ŋk/|[ˈbɛ̃ŋk]|a=US,CA}}
*** {{audio|en|en-us-bank.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|æŋk|s=1}}
* {{hyph|en|bank}}

===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|en|id=institution|:der|frm:banque<id:bank>|tree=1}}
[[File:Bank of England Building, London, UK - Diliff.jpg|thumb|The {{w|Bank of England}} is one of the first modern central '''banks''' ({{senseno|en|Q22687}}), established in 1694.]]

{{inh+|en|enm|banke}}, from {{der|en|frm|banque}}, from {{der|en|it|banca||counter, moneychanger's bench or table}}, from {{der|en|lng|bank||bench, counter}}, from {{der|en|gmw-pro|*banki}}, from {{der|en|gem-pro|*bankiz||bench, counter}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*bʰeg-||to turn, curve, bend, bow}}. {{doublet|en|bench|banc|banco}}.

For the bench-bank relation, compare typologically {{m+|ru|ла́вка}}, {{m|ru|прила́вок}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{senseid|en|Q22687}} {{lb|en|countable}} An [[institution]] where one can place and borrow [[money]] and take care of [[financial]] affairs.
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-06-01|volume=407|issue=8838|page=71
|title=[http://www.economist.com/news/finance-and-economics/21578670-peer-peer-lending-needs-new-name-end-peer-show End of the peer show]
|passage=Finance is seldom romantic. But the idea of peer-to-peer lending comes close. This is an industry that brings together individual savers and lenders on online platforms.{{...}}'''Banks''' and credit-card firms are kept out of the picture. Talk to enough people in the field and someone is bound to mention the “democratisation of finance”.}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A [[branch office]] of such an institution.
#: {{syn|en|Lombard house<q:archaic>}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} An underwriter or [[controller]] of a [[card game]].
#: {{syn|en|banker|banque}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A fund from [[deposits]] or [[contributions]], to be used in transacting [[business]]; a [[joint]] [[stock]] or [[capital]].
#* {{RQ:Bacon Essayes|chapter=Of Usury|passage=Let it be no '''bank''' or common stock, but every man be master of his own money.}}
# {{lb|en|gambling|countable}} The sum of money etc. which the [[dealer]] or [[banker]] has as a [[fund]] from which to draw [[stake]]s and pay [[loss]]es.
# {{lb|en|slang|uncountable}} [[money|Money]]; [[profit]].
# {{lb|en|countable}} In certain games, such as [[domino]]s, a fund of [[piece]]s from which the players are allowed to draw.
# {{lb|en|countable|mostly|in combination}} A [[safe]] and [[guaranteed]] place of [[storage]] for and [[retrieval]] of important items or goods.
#: {{co|en|[[blood bank|blood '''bank''']]; [[data bank|data '''bank''']]; [[sperm bank|sperm '''bank''']]}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A device used to store coins or currency.
#: {{ux|en|If you want to buy a bicycle, you need to put the money in your piggy '''bank'''.}}
# {{lb|en|countable|music}} A collection of instrument data on a digital [[synthesizer]].
#: {{ux|en|All of the drum kits are on '''bank''' 1.}}

===Etymology 2===
{{etymon|en|id=river edge}}
[[File:Perfume River Bank, as seen from Trường Tiền Bridge, 2019.jpg|thumb|A river '''bank''' ({{senseno|en|Q2897058}})]]

From {{inh|en|enm|bank}}, {{m|enm|banke}}, from {{inh|en|ang|*banca|t=bench}} (attested in {{cog|ang|hōbanca|t=couch}} and {{inh|en|ang|banc|t=bank, hillock, embankment}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*bankō}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*bankô}}. Akin to {{cog|non|bakki|t=elevation, hill}}, {{cog|no|bakke|t=slope, hill}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q2897058}} {{lb|en|hydrology}} An [[edge]] of [[river]], [[lake]], or other [[watercourse]].
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Julius Caesar|I|i|passage=Tiber trembled underneath her '''banks'''.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=June 8, 1943|title=Jap Remnants Suffer Heavy Casualties: Alerts In Chungking
|url=https://archive.org/details/dli.granth.10715/|journal=w:The Bombay Chronicle|volume=XXXI|issue=134|page=1|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/dli.granth.10715/
|text=On the opposite '''bank''' of the river other Chinese units attacked Taoshih and Yunmeng north-west of Hankow.}}
#* {{RQ:Guardian|author=Ian Jack|title=Is this the end of Britishness|url=http://www.theguardian.com/politics/commentisfree/2014/sep/16/-sp-is-this-the-end-of-britishness|date=16 September 2014
|passage=Just upstream of Dryburgh Abbey, a reproduction of a classical Greek temple stands at the top of a wooded hillock on the river’s north '''bank'''.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20261013071747/https://www.theguardian.com/politics/commentisfree/2014/sep/16/-sp-is-this-the-end-of-britishness|archivedate=13 October 2026}}
# {{senseid|en|shoal such as sandbank}} {{lb|en|nautical|hydrology}} An [[elevation]] under the sea; a shallow area of shifting [[sand]], [[gravel]], [[mud]]{{,}} and so forth
#: {{syn|en|bar<id:shoal such as sandbank>}}
#: {{co|en|the '''banks''' of Newfoundland}}
# {{senseid|en|slope}} {{lb|en|geography}} A [[slope]] of earth, sand, etc.; an [[embankment]].
# {{senseid|en|incline}} {{lb|en|aviation}} The [[incline]] of an aircraft, especially during a turn.
# {{senseid|en|hill}} {{lb|en|rail}} An [[incline]], a [[hill]].
# {{senseid|en|clouds}} A [[mass]] of [[cloud]]s.
#: {{ux|en|The '''bank''' of clouds on the horizon announced the arrival of the predicted storm front.}}
# {{senseid|en|coal face}} {{lb|en|mining}} The face of the coal at which miners are working.
# {{senseid|en|deposit}} {{lb|en|mining}} A deposit of ore or coal, worked by excavations above water level.
# {{senseid|en|ground}} {{lb|en|mining}} The ground at the top of a shaft.
#: {{ux|en|Ores are brought to '''bank'''.}}
